fields.climate: tropical; mild winter (October to March); hot, humid summer (March to June); humid, warm rainy monsoon (June to October)
fields.terrain: mostly flat alluvial plain; hilly in southeast
fields.hazards: droughts; cyclones; much of the country routinely inundated during the summer monsoon season
fields.resources: natural gas, arable land, timber, coal
fields.farm: rice, milk, potatoes, maize, sugarcane, onions, jute, vegetables, mangoes/guavas, tropical fruits
fields.exports: garments, footwear, fabric, textiles, trunks and cases
fields.industries: cotton, textiles and clothing, jute, tea, paper, cement, fertilizer, sugar, light engineering
fields.languages: Bangla 98.8% (official, also known as Bengali), other 1.2%
fields.legal: common law, incorporating elements of English common law; since independence, statutory law has been the primary form of legislation…
fields.military: varies by service, but generally 17-23 for voluntary military service; length of service also varies
